name: Gorgias
description_en:
Gorgias combines an ecommerce helpdesk with an AI Agent, keeping store data, customer conversations, rules and human support in one workspace. Helpdesk can support several ecommerce platforms, while the current AI Agent setup and handover guides specifically require a connected Shopify store. Store context and action permissions therefore need to be scoped separately from a generic omnichannel inbox claim.

Its commercial unit is mainly support usage, with ticket fees, automated-interaction fees and optional Voice/SMS charges rather than a single unlimited per-agent subscription. Some events can count toward more than one product. This profile explains rule execution, AI handoff and billable-event boundaries; no store, ticket, action, test conversation or bill was executed.
description_zh:
Gorgias 将电商帮助台与 AI Agent 结合，在一个工作空间内保存商店数据、客户对话、规则及人工支持。Helpdesk 可支持多种电商平台，而当前 AI Agent 配置和交接指南明确要求连接 Shopify 商店，因此商店背景和动作权限需与泛化多渠道收件箱声明分别明确。

其商业单位主要是支持用量，分工单费、自动化互动费及可选 Voice／SMS 费用，并非单一无限每坐席订阅。某些事件可同时计入多个产品。本文解释规则执行、AI 交接及计费事件边界，未实际运行商店、工单、动作、测试对话或账单。

core_features.name_zh: 电商收件箱及商店背景
core_features.explanation_en: Use customer/order context and supported store actions alongside support conversations.
core_features.explanation_zh: 在支持对话旁使用客户／订单背景及支持的商店动作。

core_features.explanation_en: Create event-triggered conditions/actions that apply across stores unless explicitly filtered.
core_features.explanation_zh: 建立事件触发条件／动作，若未明确筛选，规则跨商店适用。

core_features.explanation_en: AI Agent uses at least one knowledge source; actions must be included in skills or guidance to run.
core_features.explanation_zh: AI Agent 至少需一个知识来源，动作必须加入技能或指导才可运行。

core_features.explanation_en: Separate escalation topics, ignored tickets and channel-specific confirmation, email capture and failure messaging.
core_features.explanation_zh: 区分升级主题、忽略工单及各渠道确认、邮箱收集和失败消息。

en: Evaluate a Shopify order-status or cancellation skill with an actual store-permission boundary.
Route multistore tickets and inspect both the human takeover and resulting billable events.
zh: 评估 Shopify 订单状态或取消技能及真实商店权限边界。
路由多商店工单，并检查人工接手和对应计费事件。
use_cases.basis: Editorial evaluation tasks, not observed customer outcomes or executed transactions.

AI prerequisites and rules.en: Current AI setup guide requires an active subscription, Shopify connection and Lead/Admin/Owner role. Rules have account-wide store/channel scope unless conditions narrow them; up to70 rules described.
AI prerequisites and rules.zh: 当前 AI 配置指南要求活跃订阅、Shopify 连接及 Lead／Admin／Owner 角色。规则默认跨账户商店／渠道，需条件缩小范围，文档描述最多70条规则。

steps.en: Verify the connected Shopify store, app permissions and selected AI subscription/role.
steps.zh: 核对已连接 Shopify 商店、应用权限及所选 AI 订阅／角色。

steps.en: Add a knowledge source, configure one skill and attach only the actions and store scope intended for that skill.
steps.zh: 加入知识来源、配置一个技能，并只附加该技能预期动作及商店范围。

steps.en: Test answers and handover, then separately verify authorized action results, queue ownership and billing/usage.
steps.zh: 测试回答及交接，再分别验证获授权动作结果、队列归属及账单／用量。

items.name: Shopify
items.scope: Explicit AI Agent prerequisite; previously connected apps may need permissions updated. Actions require inclusion in skill/guidance.

items.name: WooCommerce, BigCommerce and Magento Helpdesk integrations
items.scope: Helpdesk comparison lists these platforms with plan conditions. Does not establish the same AI Agent setup path or every write capability.

items.name: Voice and SMS
items.scope: Separately subscribed usage products; a single customer ticket can generate independent Voice/SMS billable events.

items.en: When chat is offline, or online email capture is required, a shopper who supplies no email causes AI Agent to close the ticket. That is not evidence the underlying issue was solved.
items.zh: 聊天离线或在线要求邮箱时，客户不提供邮箱会使 AI Agent 关闭工单，不能证明底层问题已解决。

items.en: Rules without store/channel conditions apply across integrations; mixing AND/OR requires nested IF rather than one mixed IF statement.
items.zh: 无商店／渠道条件的规则跨集成适用；AND／OR 混合需嵌套 IF，不能放同一个混合 IF。

pricing.billing_basis: Helpdesk ticket allowance plus selected AI automated-interaction allowance/usage and Voice/SMS add-ons; monthly/annual, legacy and extra-usage conditions vary. Dollar billing currency not explicitly established.
pricing.source_snapshot_en: Helpdesk-only monthly cards: Starter$10/50 tickets/3seats, Basic$60/300, Pro$360/2,000, Advanced$900/5,000; latter three table seat limits500. Annual equivalents$50/$300/$750 for Basic/Pro/Advanced. AI-added monthly bundles$40/$90/$550/$1,430 with30/30/190/530 automated interactions. These are separate selectable options, not contradictory universal prices.
pricing.source_snapshot_zh: 仅Helpdesk月付卡：Starter$10／50工单／3席位，Basic$60／300，Pro$360／2,000，Advanced$900／5,000；后三档表中席位限制500。Basic／Pro／Advanced年付折月$50／$300／$750。含AI月付组合$40／$90／$550／$1,430，含30／30／190／530自动化互动。属于分别可选项，非相互冲突通用价格。

faq.question_en: Can one AI-resolved ticket incur two fees?
faq.question_zh: 一张 AI 解决工单可产生两种费用吗？
faq.answer_en: Under the detailed current model, a ticket fully resolved by AI Agent without human takeover can incur both Helpdesk and automation fees. Legacy models and non-AI automation paths differ.
faq.answer_zh: 详细当前模式中，AI Agent 完全解决且无人接手的工单可同时产生 Helpdesk 和自动化费。旧模式及非 AI 自动化路径不同。

faq.question_en: Will merging tickets always reduce the usage count?
faq.question_zh: 合并工单总能减少计费用量吗？
faq.answer_en: No. The billing guide keeps relevant billable events: merging two billable Voice tickets still counts two Voice tickets, and Email+Voice can retain both product charges.
faq.answer_zh: 不能。账单指南保留相关计费事件：两张可计费 Voice 合并仍计两张 Voice，Email＋Voice 可保留两个产品费用。

faq.answer_en: The setup guide says test conversations are not billed, do not affect reporting and do not send real shopper messages. That does not establish that every configured external action is safely simulated.
faq.answer_zh: 配置指南称测试对话不收费、不影响报表且不向真实客户发消息，但不能据此确定每个配置外部动作都安全模拟。

review_notes: Vendor descriptions are documentation evidence, not independent reliability, usability or customer-outcome verification.
English and Chinese are paired drafts. Chinese text does not establish Chinese UI support.
All alternative relationships remain unreviewed. Public-web retrieval may use cached content; prices are dated observations.

sections.title_en: A skill defines the task; an action changes a connected app
sections.title_zh: 技能定义任务，动作改动连接应用
sections.en:
Current AI Agent setup requires an active subscription, connected Shopify and a Lead/Admin/Owner role. At least one knowledge source is required to enable it. Skills define how to handle a type of conversation, such as a return or cancellation, while actions must be explicitly included in a skill or guidance before AI Agent can run them. An action is not required simply to answer from knowledge.

For a hypothetical cancellation skill, verify the order, customer identity, policy eligibility and app permission before checking the provider-side cancellation result. Test conversations are documented as unbilled and isolated from shopper messaging/reporting, but the read guide does not establish universal simulation of every external write. No action was executed here.
sections.zh:
当前 AI Agent 配置要求活跃订阅、已连接 Shopify 及 Lead／Admin／Owner 角色，启用前至少需一个知识来源。技能定义退货或取消等类型对话的处理方式，动作必须明确加入技能或指导后才能运行；仅按知识回答不要求配置动作。

以假设取消技能为例，应先核对订单、客户身份、政策资格及应用权限，再检查服务商侧取消结果。文档说明测试对话不收费且与客户消息／报表隔离，但未确定所有外部写入都统一模拟。本文未执行动作。

sections.title_en: Rules run across stores unless you narrow their scope
sections.title_zh: 规则默认跨商店运行，需主动缩小范围
sections.en:
The rule guide permits up to seventy rules and says active rules apply across connected stores/channels. A returns auto-reply intended for one shop therefore needs an integration or channel condition. Trigger priority starts with ticket creation, then new message, ticket update, assignment, snooze ending and satisfaction response; rules within a trigger run top to bottom.

Mixed AND/OR logic requires nested IF blocks, and ELSE represents the false outcome. Evaluate overlapping rules, a tag updated by another rule, an unsolicited automatic reply and a second store’s ticket. Rule ordering can change later conditions and customer-visible actions; it is not a visual preference. Complete loop/error recovery behavior was not tested or established from these pages.
sections.zh:
规则指南允许最多70条，并说明启用规则跨已连接商店／渠道适用。因此只面向一家店的退货自动回复需添加集成或渠道条件。触发优先级从工单创建开始，依次为新消息、工单更新、分配、暂缓结束及满意度响应，同一触发器内自上而下。

AND／OR 混合逻辑需嵌套 IF，ELSE 表示假结果。应评估重叠规则、被另一规则更新的标签、非预期自动回复及第二家店工单。顺序可影响后续条件和客户可见动作，并非显示偏好。本文未测试或确定完整循环／错误恢复行为。

sections.title_en: Escalation, exclusion and failed handoff are different states
sections.title_zh: 升级、排除及交接失败是不同状态
sections.en:
The October guide describes built-in handover signals, configured topics and insufficient answer quality. Excluding a ticket with the Prevent AI Agent from answering rule instead applies ai_ignore and routes it to an ignore view. That is different from an AI conversation handed to a team. Per-store configuration matters.

Chat normally asks for confirmation unless the shopper explicitly requests a person. Online/offline/error instructions differ; offline chat always requests email, and required-email capture can close a ticket if none is supplied. Handover failure has a fallback message. A reported close therefore does not prove resolution or successful human follow-up. Set an accountable handover team using ai_handover rules and available-agent assignment, then inspect actual ownership.
sections.zh:
10月指南描述内置交接信号、配置主题及回答质量不足。用 Prevent AI Agent from answering 规则排除工单则添加 ai_ignore 并进入忽略视图，与 AI 对话转交团队不同，按商店配置也重要。

聊天通常先请求确认，客户明确要求人工时例外。在线／离线／错误指令不同；离线总会要求邮箱，强制邮箱场景下未提供可导致关单。交接失败有兜底消息。因此关单不证明解决或人工成功跟进。应通过 ai_handover 规则和可用人员分配明确负责团队，再检查实际归属。

sections.title_en: A reply and an automated outcome are separate billing events
sections.title_zh: 回复与自动化结果是独立计费事件
sections.en:
The September billing guide counts a Helpdesk ticket after any reply from a human, AI Agent or rule, regardless of the number of subsequent messages. An inbound request with no helpdesk reply, internal note or assignment alone does not count. Under the described current AI model, a completely AI-resolved ticket can also incur an automation fee; AI-to-human handover instead incurs the ticket fee. Non-AI Flows/Order Management/article paths can incur only an automation fee.

The guide uses a seventy-two-hour no-human-intervention condition for an automated interaction. This is a billing definition, not independent evidence of customer satisfaction. Proactive search messages and AI FAQ clicks have distinct fee cases. Voice and SMS subscribe and count separately, and a single thread can contain a Helpdesk, Voice and SMS billable event. Verify actual usage in Billing & usage against representative tickets.
sections.zh:
9月账单指南将人工、AI Agent 或规则发出任何回复后的 Helpdesk 工单计费，不随后续消息数增加。只有接收未回复、内部备注或分配本身不计。所述当前 AI 模式中，AI 完全解决还可产生自动化费，AI 转人工则产生工单费；非 AI 的 Flow／Order Management／文章路径可只产生自动化费。

指南用72小时无人工介入条件定义自动化互动，这是计费定义，不是独立客户满意证据。主动搜索消息与 AI FAQ 点击有不同费用情形。Voice 和 SMS 独立订阅计量，一条线程可含 Helpdesk、Voice及SMS计费事件。应将 Billing & usage 与代表性工单对账。

sections.title_en: Splitting and merging do not erase all billable history
sections.title_zh: 拆分及合并不能抹除全部计费历史
sections.en:
A reply after sufficient inactivity can create a new ticket that becomes billable if the helpdesk replies. The guide specifies more than ten days for email and more than three days for several other channels, regardless of open/closed status. A shopper returning to the same apparent issue is not necessarily the same billing event.

Merging a billable email with an unanswered email leaves one billable ticket, but two billable Voice tickets remain two Voice events. Email merged with Voice can retain one of each product fee. Accounts created before May 28, 2025 may remain on a legacy model unless specified AI/Shopping Assistant upgrades changed it. Do not apply the new double-fee example to every historic contract, or assume merging reverses an invoice.
sections.zh:
充分闲置后的回复可创建新工单，帮助台再回复后可计费。指南规定邮件超过10天，其他若干渠道超过3天，不因开放／关闭状态改变。客户回到看似同一问题，不一定属于同一计费事件。

可计费邮件与未答邮件合并留下1张可计费工单，但两张可计费 Voice 仍保留2个 Voice事件；Email与Voice合并可各留1个产品费。2025年5月28日前账户可能保留旧模式，除非指定 AI／Shopping Assistant 升级改变计费。不能把新双费示例用于全部历史合同，也不能假定合并会撤销账单。

sections.title_en: Compare the selected package and expected usage, not one headline
sections.title_zh: 比较所选组合及预期用量，而非单一标题
sections.en:
The current page contains separate monthly/annual and Helpdesk-only/AI-added cards. Helpdesk-only monthly prices shown are $10 for fifty tickets, $60 for three hundred, $360 for two thousand and $900 for five thousand. The AI-added monthly examples are $40/$90/$550/$1,430, with separate interaction allowances. Annual equivalents and overage differ. Starter has three seats and the other displayed tiers five hundred; usage pricing is not unlimited seats.

Choose the actual toggle/package, confirm currency, AI unit rate, extra-ticket packs, Voice/SMS eligibility and renewal together. Over-limit usage can generate overage charges. A free signup/trial button does not establish a sustained-free helpdesk. Ecommerce teams with Shopify data and clear policies have concrete evaluation tasks; exact license, regional availability, data retention, exports/restore and UI language coverage remain unverified. No ROI, automation rate, revenue attribution or zero-downtime claim was independently tested.
sections.zh:
当前页面有分别的月付／年付和仅Helpdesk／含AI卡。仅Helpdesk月付显示50工单$10、300工单$60、2,000工单$360、5,000工单$900；含AI月付示例$40／$90／$550／$1,430，并有独立互动额度。年付折月及超额不同。Starter为3席位，其他显示档500席位，按用量定价不等于席位无限。

应选择真实开关／组合，一起确认币种、AI单价、额外工单包、Voice／SMS资格及续订。超额用量可收费，免费注册／试用按钮不能证明持续免费帮助台。已有Shopify数据和明确政策的电商团队有具体评估任务；准确许可、地区可用性、数据保留、导出／恢复和界面语言仍未核实。ROI、自动化率、收入归因和零停机主张未独立测试。

seo.title_en: Gorgias: Ecommerce AI Handoff, Rules and Billable Ticket Events
seo.title_zh: Gorgias：电商 AI 交接、规则及工单计费事件
seo.description_en: Understand Gorgias Shopify AI prerequisites, multistore rule order, failed handoff, ticket plus automation charges, channel splits/merges and legacy billing.
seo.description_zh: 了解 Gorgias Shopify AI 前提、多商店规则顺序、交接失败、工单加自动化费、渠道拆分／合并和旧计费模式。
seo.primary_intent: Evaluate Gorgias ecommerce support execution and usage billing.
secondary_questions: Can AI resolution incur two fees?
What happens if a shopper leaves no handover email?
seo.query_basis: Editorial questions; no measured search demand or ranking.

research_gaps.en: No store connection, rule, AI, handover, external action, billing or migration tested. Actual package/currency, legacy status, quotas, actions, phone/SMS eligibility, license, regions, UI languages, export/restore and retention need selected-account confirmation.
research_gaps.zh: 未测试商店连接、规则、AI、交接、外部动作、账单或迁移。实际组合／币种、旧模式、额度、动作、电话／SMS资格、许可、地区、界面语言、导出／恢复及保留需所选账户确认。

research_gaps.en: Helpdesk supports several commerce platforms; current AI setup/handover guides are Shopify-specific. Billing overview channel scope is narrower than newer AI setup deployment list, so current channel eligibility must be verified.
research_gaps.zh: Helpdesk支持多电商平台，当前AI配置／交接指南针对Shopify；账单概览渠道范围比更新AI配置部署列表窄，应确认当前渠道资格。
